Class ControllerLessonsHome

java.lang.Object
guiLessonsHome.ControllerLessonsHome
public class ControllerLessonsHome extends Object

Title: ControllerLessonsHome

Description: The controller for the Lessons Learned Home page. It handles navigation to the create and view pages, deletion of the selected lesson, and returning to the contributor home page. Lessons are shown in the list as "[title] (ID: [id])", and the ID is parsed back out of the selected row to look up the lesson.

    • goToView

      protected static void goToView(javafx.stage.Stage theStage, entityClasses.User theUser)
      Opens the lesson selected in the list on the View / Edit Lesson page. If no row is selected, an alert is shown instead. The lesson ID is parsed from the selected row text and used to load the full lesson from the database.
      Parameters:
      theStage - the JavaFX stage on which to display the page
      theUser - the currently logged-in user

    • performDeletion

      protected static void performDeletion()
      Deletes the lesson selected in the list. If no row is selected, an alert is shown. The user is asked to confirm before the lesson is removed from the database; on success the row is also removed from the list, and an alert reports the outcome (including database failures).

      protected static void performReturn()
      Returns to the appropriate home page based on the user's active role. Curators return to the Curator Home page, while Contributors return to the Contributor Home page.
